reason: Match Raguel/Renegade big-head style, compact wings and weapons; correct Sanya to face right.

jobs.detail: ONI: make helmet HUGE and cute, 60% of height, orange eye slits facing RIGHT, tiny obsidian/navy armored torso and stubby boots. Keep jagged armor simplified, short horns, blue/violet/magenta flame flickering above head only 8% of body height. jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: transparent retro pixel fighting-game 24-frame animation atlas.
Image1 is the APPROVED proportions/style reference. Image2 is the TARGET character sheet to REDESIGN. Recreate ONLY the character fromImage2, with the adorable BIG HEAD / TINY BODY proportions and bold readable pixels of Image1. The previous target heads are much too small, limbs too long, equipment too large. This is a MAJOR anatomy proportion correction. The head/face or robot helmet must occupy 55-60% of head-to-foot height, and be wider than the tiny torso. Entire figure about 1.8 heads tall. Short thick arms, stubby legs, compact round silhouette, expressive large eyes or eye slits. Preserve recognizable identity, costume and palette, not Image2's tall mature anatomy. No photorealism, no new characters.
Make EVERY weapon much smaller: its total length about HALF the character's head-to-foot height. Idle weapons held below face or beside hip so the face is completely clear. All standing idle silhouettes including equipment should be upright and compact, total width no more than 1.25 times height. Head remains the largest focal shape. Crisp dark outlines, chunky clean pixel clusters and simple cel shade steps like Image1. No diffuse background glow. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside characters.
EXACTLY FOUR columns and SIX rows, one complete sprite per cell, 24 total. Same scale, centered torso and foot baseline in each equal cell. Wide clear transparent gutters, no touching neighbors, no cropped equipment, no text or dividers. All poses face RIGHT (face, eyes and chest oriented toward screen-right opponent, never showing the back of head).
Layout left to right:
row1 FOUR distinct idle breathing frames, slight hair/cloth/energy movement.
row2 FOUR sequential movement cycle frames (walking, or winged glide for flying characters).
row3 guard, jumping, low crouch, hurt recoil.
row4 light attack: windup, contact strike, follow-through, recovery.
row5 heavy attack: windup, contact strike, follow-through, recovery.
row6 special anticipation, special contact, special follow-through, horizontal fallen knockdown.
Preserve this order exactly. Combat swings should visibly move the arms and compact weapons toward RIGHT, with small action arcs that stay inside cells. All idle faces readable even at tiny selection-menu size.
